template.source: AleviaAmla · Adrien batch 01 · 1:1 product vs habit split (Wildhorn c0178 validated)
template.production_method: collage — flat split background, cut-out product photo left, cut-out object photo right, five ✓ and five ✗ lines

decode.scroll_stop_trick: The brand's bottle faces the everyday thing the buyer already uses (coffee) with a VS badge between them, and the two columns of green ticks vs red crosses settle the fight before she reads a word.
decode.angle_carried: anti-waste: 'what you use now vs what works' (coffee crash)
decode.hidden_reading: none; the social mechanism is the familiar object turned into the loser
decode.scene_logic: no scene; a split page. Ours: the Edenvia pouch vs the cup of 'detox tea' she drinks for her swollen legs — the same cup shape, same place
decode.visual_trick: cut-out product left on the brand-colour half, cut-out everyday object right on a grey half, big VS circle on the divider — copy literally
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: cup of coffee ↔ cup of dandelion 'detox tea' with the teabag tag hanging out (same cup and saucer, same angle)
decode.render_style: flat design, green gradient left half → Edenvia blue gradient, light grey right half, photo cut-outs with soft shadow
decode.text_treatment: bold rounded sans headline (brand name in white on the colour half, black on the grey half), black VS circle, green ✅ list and red ❌ list in regular sans

strategy.angle: A8-L heavy, swollen legs — the detox tea only flushes water for a few hours
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: a 'detox tea' every evening, bathroom all night, legs heavy again by noon · cause: the tea moves water, not the inflamed tissue holding it · tried: diuretic teas, water tablets
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.
